description: The zone_threshold hangar: a cavernous prefab of corrugated steel, its floor a map of old oil stains and tyre scuffs. Tool racks and a battered workbench line one wall; a wheeled ops desk with a bank of flight monitors faces the other. The big bay doors stand open to the west, framing the ramp and the aircraft parked out on it. It smells of avgas, hot metal and cold coffee.

flags.intro_lore: Aircraft mean money, and money this far from downtown means somebody worked hard to keep it flying. The Threshold hangar runs on the same principle as everything else out here: whatever still works, works because somebody refuses to let it stop. The runway beyond looks like an invitation. It is, technically — you just have to survive whatever's waiting at the other end of the flight plan.

name: zone_threshold Hangar
